_comment: The branch a router rule or switch case routes to, read by BOTH sides:
A rule or case with a label routes to that label. One without a label gets
the id the editor gives its handle, and an edge drawn from that handle
carries that id as its label -- so the engine must return the same id, or
no edge matches. It used to return the empty label, and an empty branch
means 'every edge' (traversal.TakesEdge): a message matching an unnamed
rule was sent down every route out of the node.
index is the rule's or case's position in the node's list, counting from 0.
